title: Represent spell-list pages as covered by spell class memberships
description:
Finding sources:
- Codex reconstructed pages 105-113 and found exact parity: 70 class/level groups and 778 class spell memberships, no mismatches.
- Fable independently confirmed exact class spell-list parity both directions against pages 105-113.
- The problem is coverage accounting: pages are marked ignored:spell-list-header/header-ish rather than represented by spell.data.classes (Fable re-verified the p. 105-113 entries carry status ignored:spell-list-header in the bundle's source-coverage report).
- ChatGPT also found false ownership where p. 109 Ranger spell-list text "Commune with Nature Tree Stride" was attributed to table:circle-of-the-land-forest due to duplicate text.
- This is residual after closed spell-list parity work; create a new bead because the latest audit still found it.

Acceptance criteria:
- Source coverage reports p. 105-113 spell-list content as represented by spell class membership, not ignored.
- Preserve the parity gate and exact 70-group/778-membership reconstruction.
- Add diagnostics preventing subclass table duplicate text from owning class spell-list source lines.
- Future audit output should make it clear spell-list source content is represented, not ignored.
close_reason: Spell-list pages now have source-positioned structured-field coverage via spell.data.classes; parity remains exact at 70 groups and 778 memberships.
